title: Deep Dark Overworld
description: Turns the Overworld into the Deep Dark.
body:
![Deep Dark Overworld](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8f83e0db8c24a7953dd14313169a1bb235d6b25b.png)

This resource pack turns every aspect of the overworld into a deep dark version of itself. Blocks, items and mobs get overtaken by sculk and whatever dark secret the ancient cities hold. 

This resource pack is 100% vanilla friendly if you only want the blocks and items to be changed. **If you want the mobs shown on the pictures as well, you do need to download and install the mod Entity Model Features additionally.
**

The resource pack uses Vanilla Core Shader features incl. Skybox, Lightmap and Fog to immerse the player.

In my video I explain in more detail how I made the Vanilla Core Shader for this resource pack.
